title: Rate cons with notes after amounts rejected
text: The carrier-settlement queue has filled up with signed rate cons that look correct, mostly on Hartline multi-stop loads. They are rejected with "charges add up to ..., rate con total is ...". On load TW-88412, the line `Stop Off: $100.00 (1 extra stop)` is read as $1.00, and the detention rate `$75.00/hr after 2 hrs free` is read as $2.00. Rate cons with no trailing notes parse fine. The parser is `parse_rate_confirmation` in `rate_confirmation.py`.
